summary: The Advanced row: per server, whether its tools are listed to clients that get the full tool list (auto) or only found through toolport_search_tools (search), the two interop switches, the one-call-at-a-time switch (serial), the longest a call may run with the bridge ceiling that follows, and a time budget per tool (toolBudgets; local servers only) (server mode, servers_set_mode; the rest through server edit and servers_update_config). The mode and the switches apply at once with Undo, the limit and the tool budgets have Save
